hero.headline: Data-Led Real Estate Advisory Across the Asset Lifecycle
hero.subhead: RealTerra acts as an independent fiduciary for private investors, family offices, and cross-border funds navigating prime residential and commercial opportunities across Dubai and the UAE.

intro.headline: Beyond Standard Brokerage: An Institutional Mindset
intro.lead: Traditional real estate brokerage in Dubai is transactional and developer-commission aligned. RealTerra operates on an advisory model: we treat every acquisition as an institutional capital allocation, screening off-plan and secondary inventory through rigorous cash-flow stress tests, developer balance sheet audits, and yield sensitivity modeling.

services.title: Portfolio Architecture & Capital Allocation
services.tagline: Diversified multi-asset strategies engineered for risk-adjusted returns.
services.description: We build institutional investment mandates tailored to capital horizons, cash-flow requirements, and risk parameters. Strategies span high-yield urban corridors (Business Bay, Meydan), super-prime branded residences, and emerging speculative catalysts like Al Marjan Island.
capabilities: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) & Equity Multiple financial modeling
Micro-market supply pipeline and absorption risk analysis
Geographic diversification across Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, and Abu Dhabi

services.title: Developer Due Diligence & Track-Record Vetting
services.tagline: Independent forensic screening before a single dirham leaves escrow.
services.description: Not all developers are equal. We audit developer balance sheets, past handover delivery timelines, construction quality benchmarks, contractor dispute histories, and active RERA Escrow account statuses to ensure absolute capital security.
capabilities: Historical handover delay ratios and defect histories
RERA Project Escrow registration and milestone verification
Main contractor financial health and construction velocity audit

services.title: Off-Market & Pre-Launch Priority Allocation
services.tagline: First-tranche tier-1 pricing and prime unit stack selection.
services.description: Through deep institutional relationships with tier-1 master developers (Emaar, Nakheel, Ellington, Aldar, Omniyat, Meraas), we secure early allocations in high-demand developments before public release, protecting clients against launch premiums.
capabilities: Corner unit, sea-facing, and high-floor stack reservation
Direct developer payment plan term negotiation

services.title: Cross-Border Conveyancing & Legal Structuring
services.tagline: Frictionless international transactions backed by certified compliance.
services.description: From international wire routing through central bank certified channels to power-of-attorney execution and Dubai Land Department Oqood pre-registration, our conveyancing team manages every legal nuance without requiring your physical presence in Dubai.
capabilities: Sales & Purchase Agreement (SPA) forensic clause review
Offshore holding company & DIFC Foundation asset structuring
Cross-border currency clearing and banking facilitation

services.title: UAE 10-Year Golden Visa Residency Facilitation
services.tagline: Turnkey long-term sovereignty and family relocation advisory.
services.description: We streamline the entire Golden Visa application directly with the Dubai Land Department (DLD Cube) and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP), managing medical fitness, Emirates ID biometric scheduling, and dependent sponsorship.
capabilities: Full family and domestic employee residency sponsorship

services.title: Post-Handover Asset Management & Exit Realization
services.tagline: Yield optimization, premium leasing oversight, and strategic liquidity.
services.description: Our engagement extends through the asset lifecycle. We supervise architectural snagging, furnish for high-occupancy corporate leasing or short-term vacation rental, screen premium tenants, and time secondary market exits at peak market liquidity.
capabilities: Comprehensive handover snagging inspection and defect remediation
Short-term (Airbnb/holiday home) vs. long-term yield optimization
Secondary resale syndication and institutional portfolio block sales

phases.name: Mandate Discovery
phases.summary: Clarifying capital objectives, target hold period (3–10 years), liquidity appetite, and expected yield profile.

phases.name: Market & Asset Screening
phases.summary: Filtering through active and upcoming inventory using quantitative scoring algorithms and developer forensic audits.

phases.name: Execution & Escrow Locking
phases.summary: Unit reservation, contract vetting, and secure fund routing into statutory RERA Escrow accounts.

phases.name: Lifecycle Management
phases.summary: Ongoing construction milestone monitoring, snagging, handover, tenanting, and strategic capital redeployment.
